# ethereum-optimism/docs Daily Update (Mar 12, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
The day saw the opening of a new pull request to correct a batcher configuration description and the closure of two issues related to outdated documentation and flashblocks features. Discussions continued on critical issues concerning repository size and node stability.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
A new pull request, [#2000](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/pull/2000), was opened to fix the description and syntax examples for the `max-blocks-per-span-batch` configuration variable.

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Documentation Updates
Two documentation-related issues were closed. [#618](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/618) addressed the need to update the Gas Oracle section, confirming its accuracy. [#1965](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/1965) tracked and resolved concerns regarding supported flashblocks features.

## NEW ISSUES

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Repository Bloat and Cloning Challenges
Discussion continued on [#19241](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19241), which highlights the significant size of the `optimism` repository due to historical binaries and artifacts. A recent comment from `incompleteloop` at 2026-03-12T03:13:17Z emphasized the severity of the problem, stating that cloning the repository takes over two hours and that the inclusion of Rust crates not published to crates.io further exacerbates the issue, causing timeouts. The commenter expressed astonishment that teams can effectively work with such a bloated codebase.

### Critical Node Crash Loop
Issue [#19509](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/19509) details a critical error where `DepositsOnlyPayloadAttributesRequestEvent` can lead to a permanent node crash loop, particularly under conditions involving the SuperAuthority deny path. The latest comment from `ajsutton` at 2026-03-12T20:52:54Z referenced alternative solutions, including a pull request ([#19465](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19465)) and Claude's attempt at writing tests ([#19466](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/19466)), though `ajsutton` noted that the proposed tests might be too narrowly scoped for confidence in a fix.

### Batcher Configuration Mismatch
Issue [#1933](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/issues/1933) addresses a mismatch in the description and example for the `max-blocks-per-span-batch` configuration variable, which incorrectly references `check-recent-txs-depth`. `romanito0410` commented at 2026-03-12T04:40:31Z that a pull request, [#2000](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/docs/pull/2000), has been opened to fix this issue.
